name: Memory redo
summary: A one-year-ago trip memory that flips into a re-plan: the crew votes on a weekend and it locks with a countdown.
useWhen: an anniversary of a group trip or night out comes up
'1 year ago today', 'we have to do this again', 'same trip next year?'
dontUseWhen: a recap with costs and stops (use trip-story)
planning a first trip with no shared memory
